propositions: Plan-review grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing/unverifiable even when a prerequisite ticket will create them, because they only check the origin/main snapshot and ignore depends_on prerequisites.

The prose rule stating 'a symbol created by a ticket this ticket depends_on is treated as EXISTING' is not implemented in code; it must be wired into the advisory lane of det_floor without adding a blocking check.

A machine-parseable inline citation syntax [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be introduced to ground cross-ticket references, verified bidirectionally (P depends_on C or C blocks P) and never blocking (fail-open).

Layer-2 LLM grounding judgment must credit a citation only if the cited ticket's plan/file_impact affirmatively establishes the specific missing functionality; uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed citations remain ungrounded (fail-closed).
Reverse-lookup failures (show_ticket/resolve_deps exceptions) must be caught and treated as unverified citations, with no exception propagating into the advisory lane.
Behavioral evaluation across two plan fixtures confirms Layer-2 coverage protocol suppresses missing-symbol findings for verified+covered citations and preserves findings otherwise.
